description: Load a page through ScrapeUnblocker and return a JSON list of its notable elements (links, inputs, buttons, selects, etc.) with a ready-to-use `selector` for each, plus tag, text and useful attributes (name, id, type, placeholder, aria_label, href, ...). Read-only and does not interact with the page. This is the discovery half of interactive scraping: call `list_elements` to find the selectors you need, then pass matching `steps` to `fetch_html` to click/type/select and capture the resulting HTML.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

url.description: The absolute URL whose elements you want to list.

name: list_elements
title: List page elements (selector discovery)
